policy.scope: All enumerated current coach teaching surfaces and finite operational bodies, including optional selected-finding/cue/note playback. No runtime selection change or new production speech has been implemented.
policy.defaults: Recommend leaving the three transient loading/checking states and defensive no-claim fallback silent. They remain counted for complete visible-copy accounting. Other examples are not instructions to speak every line automatically.
policy.game: Retain family-specific gates and exact selected claim identity from walter-dialogue-inventory.json. The 21 secondary scripts require explicit secondary-surface policy; do not silently narrate hidden popovers.
practice: practiceIntent accepts only authorized API feedback; cold cards cannot use future frames, summary, grade, source-game findings or expression as answer hints.
explain_review requires an attempt belonging to this session or completed session before solution access. No pre-answer narration.
No success narration on reveal or restored GET feedback. User-invoked replay may narrate existing evidence, but must not emit a fresh grading reward.
Scope selection to current session, attempt, analysis and exact frame/finding. Cancel on retry, navigation, hide/unmount and coach change. Current error/pending state suppresses stale chess claims.

Current public fields are insufficient for reliable new selectors in some cases: frame lacks explicit promotion/castling/checkmate/escaped-check facts, summary is plain prose, and finding rule IDs collapse some detailed branches. Future producer-side structured speech projection is required; do not parse arbitrary text or infer grading from expressions.

Existing game clip reuse is a new factual mapping, not direct use of the current game-only gate. In SRS the exact attempted line is authoritative; accepted Finding.direction=missed_opportunity means opportunity found in this answer, not a missed move.
Whole-frame combinations retain capture, promotion and king state together; no need for separate actor/target/promoted-piece pronunciation files because those exact identities stay written.

Detailed finding variants retain concrete mechanisms and stated material outcomes. Generic motif recordings are used only where the producer itself presents no stronger distinctive mechanism or outcome.
otherSurfaces: Puzzle outcomes require separate rejected, accepted-next, clean solved, failed-then-solved, and revealed recordings; none is objectively Best.

Opening recall acceptance means membership in snapshot selected repertoire. Main coach body deliberately uses the same neutral accepted line regardless of an earlier failure; relearning outcome remains in separate receipt.
Opening recall errors share the exact same useReviewSession gradingError producer as SRS, so srs-practice-error can be reused without losing authority or recovery semantics.
Puzzle and lesson errors require reload, unlike review retry. Do not reuse the SRS try-again script for their errors.
Lesson completed wording does not distinguish clean/failed/assisted; no unwarranted success claim is introduced.
Recorded clips must retain user action/restored-state policy; listing a visible message does not authorize automatic replay on GET/load.

policy.wording: Current authored lesson text contains SAN/squares. Pronunciation editing and listening review must precede generation. Text-character counts below are exact draft input sizes, not final billed credits or guaranteed take counts.
policy.narration: One or more complete supported sentences may be presented explicitly; this is not chopped-word assembly. Repetition alternatives, emotional retakes, localization and other coaches are not multiplied into the count.
policy.generation: Only the eight walter-contrasts-plan.json auditions were requested/generated. The remainder needs script and delivery approval. Preserve the bounded existing recording CLI; minimum 26 batches at its 20-request cap if every catalogue item is eventually recorded.
